'''Hunnos Jarkey's Ranch''' was a ranch located near the city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:CtEM" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the wanted murderer [[Hunnos Jarkey]] lived secretly in the ranch after he escaped the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. For his protection, he recruited a small army of [[Naboo pirates]] and fortified the area. Nevertheless, Hunnos Jarkey and all pirates were killed during a RSF assault.<ref name="SWG:CtEM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hunnos Jarkey's Ranch was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CtEM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Hunnos Jarkey's Ranch was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
